name: RST3 Component Contract
description: Frozen specification and staircasing contract for robust source training components M1, M2, and M3.

R2.description: Event-balanced sampling and flood-aware loss enabled

R3.description: Full composite: event-balanced sampling, flood-aware loss, and paired SAR augmentation enabled

M1.name: event_balanced_sampling
M1.semantics: Epoch length equals N total eligible training samples; event identities sampled approximately uniformly across E training events; deterministic sample queue with recycling without replacement until exhausted.

M2.name: training_only_flood_aware_loss
M2.semantics: Class weights computed solely from training-event valid pixels, applied to cross-entropy term only; macro soft-dice unchanged.
M2.formula: p_c = N_c / N_total; raw_w_c = 1 / sqrt(max(p_c, epsilon)); w_c = raw_w_c / mean(raw_w); w_c = clip(w_c, 0.5, 2.0); final_w_c = w_c / mean(w_c)

M3.name: synchronized_paired_sar_augmentation
M3.semantics: Transforms operate on linear amplitude backscatter prior to clipping [0.0, 0.15] and standardization; synchronized across temporal pairs and polarizations.
